product_metadata.title: Oggi Stainless Steel Roll Top Bread Box, Silver, 17.50 Inch by 7.50 Inch by 11.50 Inch
features: EXTRA LARGE BREADBOX FOR KITCHEN COUNTERTOP: This sleek bread holder for kitchen counter (Measuring 17.5" x 7.5" x 11.5") perfectly fits multiple large loaves of bread and other freshly baked foods such as cookies, bagels, muffins and more; keep your baked goods fresh & declutter kitchen countertops.
CONTEMPORARY BREAD BOX - STAINLESS KITCHEN STYLE: This airtight bread box looks great in a modern kitchen and will compliment stainless steel appliances perfectly.
PREMIUM QUALITY: This Oggi bread keeper is made from durable stainless steel and features a strong, stainless steel roll top lid with handle for easy access.
SMART BREAD STORAGE FOR KITCHEN COUNTER: Use this countertop bread box to keep all kinds of bread fresh for longer!

VERSATILE: This extra large bread box from Oggi is very versatile and can be used to keep all types of baked goods fresh and tidy. Oggi's bread boxes for kitchen counter are sized large and can even be used for medication storage.
description: FRESH BREAD, TIDY COUNTERTOP, STYLISH KITCHEN! Practical and contemporary. This large stainless steel bread box is a fantastic bread storage container whilst reducing countertop clutter and looking amazing in your kitchen. Made of durable stainless steel, these metal bread boxes will last and last. This sleek and extra large bread holder for kitchen counter is optimally sized (15.25”x9.5”x8.5”) and perfectly fits multiple large loaves of bread and other freshly baked foods such as cookies, bagels, muffins and more. Oggi's bread boxes for kitchen counter are sized large and can even be used for medication storage.
